chose: the MAP figure splits the atlas's ONE relation into three drawn classes — promotion (a spine step), reach (a resource grab that terminates), supply (an ambient source that is not a step) — derived from graph degree: SOURCE=never a destination, SPINE=both, SINK=never an origin; the spine is the longest simple path from the source with the most heat
over: one arrow type for all fourteen crossings (the layered DAG and the matrix both did this, and both were rejected: a reader cannot tell a step from a grab)
adding an explicit `kind` to atlas.transitions in this pass
because: measured on hoist: 4 promotions + 8 reaches + 2 supply = 14, all accounted. The classification is INFERRED from degree, not recorded — honest but derived; the config proposal is journaled separately

chose: break the entry tie on total heat along the path, not on path length
over: path length alone (it TIES on hoist: browser-client and config both reach patient in 4 stages)
declaring the first source in spec order the entry
because: the brief asserted config takes a 'shorter path'; measuring it, both sources reach the same depth. Heat is the honest discriminator — the entry is where traffic actually enters: api heat 0.089 vs envStr 0.0064, a 14x gap. Re-run: jq '.map.crossings.shown[]|select(.from=="config" or .from=="browser-client")' docs/coherence/index.json

chose: left-edge count is at PARITY (42 new vs 39 old, same instrument; the brief quoted 43), not reduced — and I stopped chasing it
over: cutting the region-box outlines, which would have bought 6 edges
snapping resource boxes to the stage lattice, which costs 300px of width and buys 1
because: measured: 20 of the page's 42 edges are the roster and masthead and are identical in both figures; of the figure's 22, EIGHTEEN are nine boxes each contributing a border edge and a name edge. Boxes are what the arrows point at and what makes a stage a stage — the matrix scored better precisely because it drew none. Alignment was never the defect; the brief says so itself

chose: atlas.transitions should carry an explicit `kind` (promotion | reach | supply) instead of the figure inferring it from graph degree
couldBe: the instrument is wrong — the thing that PRODUCED this number, not the thing it describes

the degree inference is right on every project and the field would be pure redundancy — measured on hoist it reproduces all 14 crossings with zero corrections, and it self-corrects when the shape changes

the inference is right on hoist only because hoist's regions happen to have clean degrees; a project where a resource is ALSO a stage for some other flow would be misclassified and could not be corrected without the field
discriminatedBy: run readMap over the atlas of three more projects and count crossings whose inferred kind an author would dispute. Zero disputes on all three: do not add the field. One or more: the field earns its config surface, and the inference becomes the default rather than the only answer

chose: resource boxes are drawn ONCE and shared, and the reach lanes are grouped by SINK rather than by stage
over: grouping lanes by the stage that grabs them
drawing a resource box under each stage that reaches it
because: grouping by sink puts every guard landing on a resource in one left-aligned column directly above its box — the drop x, the label x and the box's own name x are ONE alignment line. Grouping by stage zigzagged the labels across four x positions for no gain; duplicating the box would turn one shared thing into several, which is the fact the band exists to state (storage is reached by 4 guards from 2 stages)

chose: the figure's organ BANDS are gone; organ ownership survives only as data-owner + the roster
over: keeping the matrix's contiguous per-organ row bands
because: organs cut ACROSS the spine — on hoist six components own crossings in three different classes, so an organ band over a spine picture is a bounding box around scattered things. The join is not lost: clicking an organ still lights its guards wherever they landed (verified in a browser: shared/auth lights verifySession + 3 reaches), and the ORGAN ROSTER below the figure is unchanged
